title: Analyze CloudTrail Logs
description: Review CloudTrail logs for any anomalies related to the suspicious IAM user and their activities.
recommended_next_focus: Look for patterns indicating unauthorized access or data exfiltration.

title: Verify Access Key Usage
description: Inspect IAM user-created access keys to ensure they were authorized for the intended operations.
recommended_next_focus: Confirm if the access keys were misused.

title: Investigate Suspicious IAM User Activity
description: Review IAM user activity logs for signs of unauthorized access or data exfiltration.
recommended_next_focus: Identify the root cause of the suspicious IAM user behavior.
